title: CardCorpus exchange rates
description: The newest exchange rates, per euro: a price in currency A is `amount / rates[A] * rates[B]` in currency B. Served by index.json's `prices.rates`, not in this tree (https://pokemon.cardcorpus.com/v1/docs/guide.md#prices).

day.description: The day the rates are for.

base.description: The currency every rate is per one of.

rates.description: Each currency, by its ISO 4217 code, with how many of it one euro buys.
